rationale: Structure: omits markdown metadata (type, id, tags, confidence, etc.) and leaves 'why_it_matters' fields empty across topic_map, indicating incomplete schema population. Faithfulness: no invented strings; all candidate content matches markdown. Coverage: missing entire 'Why it matters' explanations from every topic_map entry; also missing metadata. Precision: all quotes, names, and numbers are verbatim and exact. Compression: largely replicates markdown sections verbatim; density is acceptable but no summarization or elimination of redundant detail, lowering high-density aim.
